description: Image of a ladder back chair and a horse skull hanging on the adobe wall under the portal. Handwritten by Georgia O'Keeffe in black ink on verso: "This is at the end of//the Portal—beyond//the ladder. That chair//I paid ninety eight//cents for 22 years//ago. One thing I have//that is worth its price.//It isn't an antique. It is//from Montgomery Ward.//G"
title: Skull and Chair
